_note: Numeric tokens in the manuscript with no counterpart in phase1/reports/. Every entry needs a reason; the checker fails on any token that is neither matched nor listed here, so this file is the record of what a human signed off.

section_numbers.reason: Numbered headings and cross-references, not measurements.

reference_years.reason: Publication years inside citations and the reference list.

statistical_constants.reason: Conventional thresholds defined in the text rather than estimated: significance level, the normal quantile for a 95% interval, and the calibrated-confidence cut-offs.

software_versions.reason: Pinned tool and client versions, recorded in the environment files rather than in reports/.

tp53_midband_count.reason: Table 4, the mid-band-excluded TP53 label definition: 181 of 192 variants have |RFS| >= 0.5. The count is computed at runtime in phase1/src/phase4_external_tp53.py (mask05) and written to no output file, so it has no literal source. It is verifiable from the shipped data/external/tp53_splice_scored.parquet, and the proper fix is for phase4 to emit it alongside the metrics rather than to keep this entry.

tavtigian_thresholds.reason: Likelihood-ratio thresholds of the Tavtigian point system at a prior of 0.10 (350 Very strong, 18.7 Strong, 4.33 Moderate, 2.08 Supporting). These are constants from the cited literature, not pipeline outputs; they are recorded in phase1/src/phase5_likelihood_ratios.py as ACMG_TIERS and are what the measured ratios are compared against.

method_constants.reason: Configuration constants of the analysis, not values it produces: the gene-clustered bootstrap resample count (2,000, phase3_calibration.N_BOOT and phase5.N_BOOT) and the ECE bin count (10, phase3_calibration.ece). They are recorded in the source, are quoted in Methods as parameters, and no results/ file stores them. Listed individually rather than exempting the paragraphs, which also state measured values.

companion_atlas_counts.reason: Properties of the companion atlas's frozen matrix (functional-standard-atlas, version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22637468), not of this pipeline, so no phase1/reports/ file can carry them. 46,392 is that atlas's SNV count (it spans 64,178 variants: 46,392 SNVs and 17,786 indels) and 21,394 is its overlap with this manuscript's 21,410-SNV analysis set; the sixteen unshared are RAD51C SNVs absent from the RAD51C deposit used there. Both are stated in the companion manuscript, which whitelists this manuscript's 21,410 from the other side for the same reason. Sourcing them locally would mean shipping the companion's matrix into this repository.
